## Highlights
### Improved
- Crest for Mac is one download with both engines. Copies of the separate WebKit download update to it automatically. - Extension popups, such as a password manager's settings popout, open as a tab in your current window instead of a new window.
### Fixed
- Clicking a field in the other half of a split view lets you type there on the first click. - Crest no longer quits when an extension closes its popup window, as Bitwarden does after you turn on unlock with biometrics.
---
Development builds contain the newest changes and may be less reliable than stable releases.
